text: Today is Skanda Shashthi — a sacred day to engage in the sadhana of Lord Skanda.
- Perform abhishekam to the Vel, or light a diya before a picture of Skanda Bhagwan.
- Chant the mantra 'Om Saravana Bhava' 108 times.
- Recite or listen to the Skanda Kavacham.
- Offer a simple naivedyam with heartfelt devotion.
